invariants: Never expose exception class, stack trace, SQL, internal tenant identifiers, tokens, user emails, full request path, rejected field values or raw carrier/financial payload
HTTP status must match body status
The stable machine code and type are contract identity; user-visible detail is never parsed for branching
A forbidden foreign resource can return the same 404 public body as a nonexistent one; do not leak existence
Only classified rate-limit or dependency failures are retryable, and clients must use idempotency for commands
OptimisticLockingFailure -> 409; raw DataIntegrityViolation and SQLSTATE may not be blindly converted to 409/403
Spring Security AuthenticationEntryPoint/AccessDeniedHandler and REST ControllerAdvice must share the same factory
Jobs classify transient/permanent/reconcile and retain sanitized internal diagnostics without exposing them in HTTP
No successful result event for denied command and no unauthorized DB changes
